$comment: Allowlist and budget for PNGs tracked in git (V3 brief §9: 截图不允许无上限提交 Git；仅保留精选基线，其余归档为 CI Artifact).
Read by tests/ci/check-tracked-png-budget.mjs; that script is the authority on how these numbers are applied.
A directory absent from `directories` is a violation, not a default - adding a new screenshot bucket is a
deliberate edit to this file, which is the review moment the budget exists to create.
maxFiles per directory is the exact count after the 2026-11 cleanup (1087 -> 331 tracked PNGs), so any single
new file in any bucket turns the guard red until someone raises that bucket's number on purpose.
Ceilings were taken from `git ls-files '*.png'` immediately after the cleanup; regenerate the byte ceilings with
the command in the $howToRegenerate line if a deliberate re-capture changes file sizes.

Ceilings were lowered to the post-2026-10-31 curated count (569 -> 429 files, 70.05 -> 68.13 MB) when the duplicate table runs, the 30 undeclared audit captures and the superseded v6 matrix left the index. Only lower.

Ceilings lowered to the 2026-10-31 curated count (569 -> 428 files, 70.05 -> 68.24 MB) after the duplicate table runs, the 9 uncited audit captures, and the superseded pre-v8 console buckets (visual-v4, v5, ui-v7, ui-verbs-v6) left the index. Only lower: those four buckets are cited by no document and cover pages that visual-v3/audit now carries with the current console.

artifacts/ui/visual-v3/table/after.note: Post-fix half of the table-geometry baseline; same instrument as table/before. The four other run labels (before-fix, after-fix, review7, final) were repeated captures of the same matrix and are archived as a CI artifact.

artifacts/ui/visual-v3/table/before.note: The one table-geometry baseline kept: same instrument (tests/ui/ui-table-audit.spec.ts) on pre-fix page code. Pair with table/after.
